end.summary: Physical and chemical changes were practised with melting ghee, roasting chapati, and roasting potatoes.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised telling melting apart from dissolving and correctly explained that dissolved sugar remains present, so total mass stays 220 g. They initially described sugar as disappearing and were unsure whether dissolving was chemical, but later corrected this by explaining that the sugar can be recovered and no new substance forms. They also correctly identified melting ghee as a physical change and roasting as a chemical change. At home, ask Ananya to make a two-column list of physical and chemical changes, including one reason for each example.
